The [[Twi'lek]] daughter of Ryloth freedom fighter [[Cham Syndulla]], and widowed lover of [[Jedi]] knight [[Kanan Jarrus|Kanan Jarrus/Caleb Dume]], with whom she has a son, Jacen Syndulla, General Syndulla is an expert pilot and central figure in the formation of the [[Rebel Alliance]] in its fight against the [[Galactic Empire (Star Wars)|Galactic Empire]] after leading a small rebel insurgency on the planet of [[Lothal (Star Wars)|Lothal]] that gained the attention of Senator [[Bail Organa]]. Marshall's portrayal of Hera Syndulla has received a universally positive critical reception. ==Creation and development== The character of Hera Syndulla was first created in 2014 for the animated television show ''Star Wars Rebels''. The character was first revealed on February 20, 2014 with the announcement that she would be voiced by Vanessa Marshall in a video posted to the Star Wars YouTube channel.{{cite web |author=Star Wars |date=February 20, 2014 |title=Meet Hera, the Pilot {{!}} Star Wars Rebels |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RzopG0SGJYI |website=YouTube |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} The character was named after the Greek goddess of marriage, women and family [[Hera]], meaning "protector".{{cite web |last1=Burns |first1=James |date=June 29, 2015 |title=''Star Wars Rebels'': What's In A Name? |url=https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-rebels-whats-in-a-name |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200221131755/https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-rebels-whats-in-a-name |archive-date=February 21, 2020 |website=Star Wars |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} When Marshall was auditioning for the role, ''Star Wars Rebels'' was using a secret title but Marshall saw the character "described as a pilot who wanted to see the 'tyranny' fall" and inserted ''Star Wars'' elements like the [[Galactic Empire (Star Wars)|Empire]] into the character description when she was auditioning.{{cite web |last1=Goldman |first1=Eric |date=May 4, 2014 |title=Star Wars Rebels: Vanessa Marshall Discusses Hera and Her Own Star Wars Fandom |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2014/05/04/star-wars-rebels-vanessa-marshall-discusses-hera-and-her-own-star-wars-fandom |website=IGN |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} Syndulla's outfit in ''Rebels'' was designed to imitate a classic X-Wing pilot flight outfit that is mixed with elements from [[World War II]]-era pilot gear such as a leather shoulder assembly and flight goggles.{{cite web |last1=Filoni |first1=Dave |date=April 16, 2014 |title=''Star Wars Rebels'' Costuming 101: Hera Syndulla |url=https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-rebels-costuming-101-hera-syndulla |website=Star Wars |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} For season 3 of ''Rebels'', Hera underwent a minor redesign with more texturing added to the character model and adding a patch to signify her position as Phoenix Leader in the Rebellion's Phoenix Squadron. ==Character themes== ===Leadership=== Hera's leadership style is a more mature and emotionally intelligent one. The ''Rebels'' episode "Homecoming" deals with how Hera’s sense of duty to the whole galaxy conflicts with her father’s commitment to their home planet Ryloth. She convinces her father Cham Syndulla to widen his perspective and fight for the freedom of other planets that are not Ryloth. ===Motherhood=== Hera Syndulla serves in a mother-figure role to the rest of the Ghost Crew, mentoring them and helping to hold the group together when they would otherwise fall apart.{{cite web |last1=Potter Swan |first1=Christina |date=March 14, 2018 |title=How ''Star Wars Rebels''{{'}} Hera Broke the Mother Archetype—and Recreated It in Her Own Image |url=https://www.themarysue.com/hera-star-wars-rebels-mother-archetype/ |website=The Mary Sue |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} In particular, she forms a motherly bond with [[Ezra Bridger]] who was orphaned as a child. In 1 BBY, Syndulla became a mother to son Jacen Syndulla with the late Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus.{{cite web |last1=Johnson |first1=Mia |date=July 9, 2021 |title=The Bad Batch: Who is Hera Syndulla in Star Wars? |url=https://dorksideoftheforce.com/2021/07/09/the-bad-batch-who-is-hera-syndulla/ |website=The Dork Side of the Force |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} ==Appearances== ===Film=== ====''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' (2016)==== Hera Syndulla is mentioned in ''[[Rogue One|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' on the Rebel Alliance's [[Yavin|Yavin IV]] base when an announcer on the base intercom summons "General Syndulla" to the briefing room.{{cite magazine |last1=Breznican |first1=Anthony |date=August 24, 2022 |title=All the Star Wars Rebels references in Rogue One |url=https://ew.com/movies/rogue-one-rebels-references/ |magazine=Entertainment Weekly |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} Dave Filoni confirmed that it was indeed referencing Hera rather than her father.{{cite web |last1=Collinson |first1=Gary |date=December 24, 2016 |title=Dave Filoni on the Star Wars Rebels references in Rogue One: A Star Wars Story |url=https://www.flickeringmyth.com/2016/12/dave-filoni-on-the-star-wars-rebels-references-in-rogue-one-a-star-wars-story/ |website=Flickering Myth |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} Additionally, Hera's droid Chopper is briefly seen in the background.{{cite web |last1=Miller |first1=David |date=January 6, 2021 |title=Where To Find Star Wars Rebels' Chopper Cameo In Rogue One |url=https://screenrant.com/rogue-one-star-wars-rebels-chopper-easter-egg/ |website=ScreenRant |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} ===Television=== ====''Star Wars Rebels'' (2014-2018)==== Syndulla is a lead character in ''Rebels'' during its four seasons. ====''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' (2021)==== A 10-year-old Hera Syndulla appears in the eleventh and twelfth episodes from the first season of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch|The Bad Batch]]'' titled "Devil's Deal" and "Rescue on Ryloth". Syndulla is again voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]].{{cite web |last1=Brooks |first1=Dan |date=July 19, 2021 |title=Hera Flies Again: Vanessa Marshall on Returning as the High-Flying Pilot in ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' |url=https://www.starwars.com/news/vanessa-marshall-interview-star-wars-the-bad-batch |website=Star Wars |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} However, unlike the character's American accent in ''Rebels'', the younger Hera has a French accent from living on her native planet Ryloth.{{cite web |last1=Keane |first1=Sean |date=July 15, 2021 |title=Hera Syndulla's voice in Star Wars: The Bad Batch was inspired by Marvel |url=https://www.cnet.com/culture/entertainment/hera-syndulla-voice-in-star-wars-the-bad-batch-was-inspired-by-marvel/ |website=CNET |language=en-US |access-date=May 4, 2023}} Previously in ''Rebels'', Syndulla would slip into a French accent when she is emotional such as when arguing with her father Cham.
